They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? The user wants to arrange a flight for booking number 1234. We might need to cancel existing booking? Or just book new flight? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible". That implies maybe they want to modify booking 1234? But we don't have a tool to modify booking. We can cancel booking 1234 and then book new flight. But the user didn't ask to cancel. They just want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. Possibly they want to add a flight to that booking? But no tool for that. So maybe we just provide the cost estimate. The user wants "estimated total payable amount". That likely includes flight cost plus maybe insurance? But they didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost.

We need to authenticate first to get access token. We need client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have those. We cannot proceed. We need to ask user for credentials. But maybe we can call get_nearest_airport_by_city? No. We need to get list of airports. That requires no auth. So we can call list_all_airports. Then compute flight cost. That also doesn't require auth. So we can do that. So we can get flight cost. Then we can provide estimated total payable amount. So we can skip authentication. So we can call list_all_airports. Then compute flight cost. Then provide answer.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then compute flight cost. Then respond.
